title: Monad Onboarding Intake
description: A filled-in answer document that bootstraps a Monad environment. The core shape is generic; anything type-specific lives under an open `config` or `options` object owned by the relevant module, so adding an output type, input pattern, or modifier needs only a module, not a schema change. Never put credentials in this document.

schema_version.description: Bump only on breaking shape changes. Additive fields don't need a bump.

org_id.description: Monad organization ID, or a name the skill resolves with list_organizations.

environment_name.description: Naming prefix for created components, for example 'prod' or 'acme-poc'.

outputs.description: Destinations. Each item's `type` is a Monad output type; types listed in modules/outputs/_registry.yaml have a module documenting their `config` keys.

config.description: Open by design. Non-secret settings for this output type, documented in its module and confirmed with get_output_type.

data_model.description: Required when any output is index-based (see modules/outputs/_registry.yaml).

strategy.description: single = one index; per_source = one per input type; by_category = grouped by data category.

options.description: Open. Strategy extras such as `index_name_template` (see index-modeling.md).

data_sources.description: What the user collects, by category. Vendor names may be fuzzy; the skill resolves them to input types.

category.description: A category from data-source-catalog.md, for example 'identity', 'endpoint', 'network'.

care.description: Does the user collect this category?

vendor.description: Vendor or product, possibly fuzzy (for example 'crowdstrike').

input_types.description: Resolved Monad input types. A vendor with several feeds lists the ones chosen (see modules/inputs/multi-feed-vendors.md). Filled by the skill when omitted.

synthetic.description: Build with use_synthetic_data first, where the input supports it. Default true for the first build.

config.description: Open. Non-secret settings for the input, confirmed with get_input_type.

pipeline_layout.description: How sources map to pipelines and how mixed streams are split (see data-organization.md).

strategy.description: per_source = one pipeline per input (default). custom = described in `notes`.

unmatched.description: What happens to records no route matches. Default archive.

mixed_streams.description: Inputs that carry several data types and must be split.

source.description: The vendor or input that carries the mixed data.

split.description: edges = conditional edges in one pipeline (default). intake_pipeline = an intake pipeline feeding one pipeline per type.

match.description: How to recognize it, in words or as a field/pattern, for example "app-name is sshd or sudo".

destination.description: Output name or type this data type goes to.

modifiers.description: Cross-cutting add-ons. Each `id` selects a module under modules/modifiers/.
